problemStatement.help: What the problem is, since when, what its impact is, and what is out of scope.

goals.help: The measurable project goals with target date, metric, target value and goal achievement.

targetDate.help: When it should be reached: YYYY-MM-DD or ""; legacy data may hold free text here (e.g. KW 23).

orgChart.help: The project organisation as a tree of positions; dragging reorders or re-parents.

desc.help: The subtitle, for example the person.

pid.help: The id of the parent position, null for the top level.

bg.help: Own background colour; absent when the org chart style applies.

borderColor.help: Own border colour; absent when the org chart style applies.

borderStyle.help: Own border style; absent when the org chart style applies.

borderWidth.help: Own border width; absent when the org chart style applies.

orgStyle.help: The style of the whole org chart: background, border and connector lines. Empty colours follow the colour theme.

nodeBg.help: Background colour of all positions; "" follows the colour theme.

nodeBorderColor.help: Border colour of all positions; "" follows the colour theme.

nodeBorderStyle.help: Border style of all positions: solid, dashed or dotted.

nodeBorderWidth.help: Border width of all positions, whole number 1 to 8.

lineColor.help: Colour of the connector lines; "" follows the colour theme.

lineStyle.help: Style of the connector lines: solid, dashed or dotted.

lineWidth.help: Width of the connector lines, whole number 1 to 8.

layout.help: The layout of the org chart: where each visible position sits and its connecting lines, from the tree, the collapsed positions and the measured heights. A view only.

selectedId.help: The selected position in the org chart, or none. A view only; it is not saved.

pan.help: The offset of the org chart in the view. A view only; it is not saved.

zoom.help: The zoom factor of the org chart from 0.1 to 3. A view only; it is not saved.

userAdjusted.help: Whether pan or zoom were changed by hand; the view then no longer fits the org chart by itself.

editorOpen.help: Whether the style panel of the org chart is open. A view only; it is not saved.

collapsed.help: The ids of the collapsed positions; their subordinates are hidden. A view only; it is not saved.

heights.help: The measured heights of the positions, by id. A view only; it is not saved.

confirmGoalId.help: The goal whose deletion waits for the second confirmation, or none.

styleDraft.help: The colour value currently being dragged in the colour picker, with its style key. It reaches the org chart only when the picker closes.

dragPreview.help: The preview while dragging a position: where it would land. A view only; it is not saved.

goalDragPreview.help: The preview while dragging a goal: where it would land. A view only; it is not saved.

read.help: Read the state of the project charter: problem statement, goals, org chart and its style.

addGoal.help: Add a new, empty project goal at the end of the list.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

removeGoal.help: Delete a project goal without asking; can be undone.

params.command: The command as one object with id.

moveGoal.help: Move a project goal in the list, before another one or to the end.

params.id: The id of the goal to move.
params.beforeId: The id of the goal it goes before, or null for the end.
params.command: The command as one object with id and beforeId.

fitOrg.help: Fit the org chart: pan and zoom are reset and the view follows the window automatically again.

addOrgNode.help: Add a new position to the org chart, at the top level or below an existing position.

params.title: Name of the position, 1 to 100 characters.
params.desc: Subtitle, for example the person; at most 300 characters, "" for none.
params.parentId: The id of the parent position from read().orgChart, or null for the top level.
params.command: The command as one object with title, desc and parentId.

updateOrgNode.help: Change a position's title, subtitle and own style; style values not given inherit the org chart style.

params.title: The name of the position, for example project lead or quality assurance.
params.desc: The subtitle below the name, for example the name of the person.
params.bg: The position's own background colour; empty inherits the org chart style.
params.borderColor: The position's own border colour; empty inherits the org chart style.
params.borderStyle: The position's own border style: dashed or dotted; empty or solid inherits the org chart style.
params.borderWidth: The position's own border width from 2 to 8; 0 or 1 inherits the org chart style.
params.command: The command as one object with id, title and the other values.

setOrgNodeStyle.help: Set one style value of a single position; empty takes over the style of the whole org chart.

params.key: Which style value: bg, borderColor or borderStyle.
params.value: The value, form per key see types.OrgNodeStyle.
params.command: The command as one object with id, key and value.

setOrgNodeBorderWidth.help: Set the border width of a single position; 0 or 1 inherits the width of the whole org chart.

params.id: The id of the position from read().orgChart.
params.value: The border width as a whole number from 0 to 8; 0 and 1 inherit the org chart style, otherwise the value applies.
params.command: The command as one object with id and value.

removeOrgNode.help: Delete a position with all positions below it, without asking; can be undone. Returns the number of deleted positions.

params.command: The command as one object with id.

moveOrgNode.help: Place a position below another one and order it among its new siblings. The positions below it move along.

params.parentId: The new parent position, or null for the top level; not the position itself and none below it.
params.index: Place among the new siblings, 0 for first, or null for the end.
params.command: The command as one object with id, parentId and index.

OrgNodeStyle.bg: Background colour of this position; empty takes over the org chart style.
OrgNodeStyle.borderColor: Border colour of this position; empty takes over the org chart style.
OrgNodeStyle.borderStyle: Border style of this position: dashed or dotted; empty, shown as solid in the list, takes over the org chart style.
